content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use Modbus communication with [product_name] [version_no]? Thank you in advance, [user_name]
I have already provided an answer in another discussion: [url] No, this is not supported. [product_name] [article_no] only allows TCP/IP communication using the [version_no] protocol.

This thread is closed because the question was asked in multiple places. The second topic regarding connecting [product_name] [version_no] with Modbus RTU was also published in the [product_name] conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about Modbus compatibility with [product_name] [version_no] modules. The current hardware does not support Modbus; only TCP/IP communication via the [version_no] protocol is available, which restricts integration with devices using Modbus. Clear documentation and communication about protocol support are important for user experience.
